entry: Fade a test of the range edge when the range is still intact.
exit: Midpoint or a break of the range.
sizing_envelope: Smaller than the trend template and inside the mandate.
execution: Resting limit preferred. A touch is not a fill.
costs: Maker fee only if the order rested. Otherwise taker.
validation: Compare with buy-and-hold and with the trend template on the same data.
